rationale: The daily review-queue sweep (revalidate_review_queue) covers four item_types. voice_tells is not one of them, and nothing else closes it either: `SELECT status, count(*) FROM site_work_items WHERE item_type='voice_tells' AND status IN ('complete','verified')` returns ZERO ROWS on live clients_db (2026-08-08). Its producer sets HandlerAgent "" by design, so there is no dispatch path, no handler, and no revalidator — 25 items, every one filed 2026-07-17 on leopardessconsulting.co.uk, all still `needs_human_review` 22 days later. They are parked for ever by construction. This lane previously shipped a retraction adopter whose central claim ("nothing can close these") was FALSE and which 14 council seats accepted; the CLOSER census above is the check that was skipped that time, run first this time, and it comes back empty. The change registers a voice_tells revalidator so a finding that stopped being true can be withdrawn. It is NOT the auto-rewrite the check's own `fix` text forbids and that bugs_open/033 cites as evidence the type was filed correctly for human review: retraction never edits copy and never dispatches a rewrite, it only stops asserting a claim the current page no longer supports. The human decision about HOW to fix machine-written prose is untouched. Expected effect is real rather than notional: 13 of the 25 pages have had a component updated since their item was filed, so there is genuine change to judge. The predicate is not restated — the revalidator re-runs the emit side's own scanner, which is extracted and shared, so the two ends of an item's life cannot answer 'does this read machine-written?' differently.
submitter: bugfix_168_deployed_asset_path (retraction lane, extending sweep coverage per handoff 4.3)

plan.summary: Register a voice_tells revalidator in the review-queue sweep. Extract the emit-side voice scan into a shared, exported ScanVoiceTells so the revalidator re-runs the identical predicate instead of a second copy of it, and have that scan report how many components it actually examined so 'read nothing' cannot be mistaken for 'the copy is clean'. The verdict ladder is split into a pure function and every arm is mutation-proven.

edits.rationale: Extract the page query plus gate scan out of VoiceTellsCheck.Run into an exported ScanVoiceTells shared by both ends, and export the gate loader. VoicePageScan carries ComponentsExamined and ComponentsSkippedLocked because len(Findings)==0 otherwise collapses three different states into one: prose fixed, nothing read, and only-locked-components-read. Emitted output is unchanged: Run filters to pages with findings, so the work items this check files are byte-identical.

The revalidator. Reads spec.page_id (never the item_key, whose prefix convention burned this lane once), refuses when the site's voice_gate is gone because the standard the finding was measured against no longer exists, and otherwise re-runs the shared scan for that one page. voiceTellsVerdict is split out pure so every arm is testable without a database, the same reason validateTypeFilter is a function.

Register the type. This one line is also what widens the selection: coveredItemTypes() is derived from this map, so loadParkedReviewItems starts loading voice_tells in the same edit and the registry and the selection cannot drift.
edits.sketch:
var reviewRevalidators = map[string]reviewRevalidator{
	"unresolved_cta": revalidateNamedFields("missing"),
	"required_fields_missing": revalidateNamedFields("missing_fields"),
	"needs_section_data": revalidateNamedFields("missing"),
	"needs_page": revalidateNeedsPage,
+	// spec.page_id — does the page still trip the site's own voice gate?
+	// Re-runs the emit side's scanner rather than restating the predicate.
+	"voice_tells": revalidateVoiceTells,
}

edits.rationale: That test pins the covered set and fails on any change, telling the author to update it and say why. It fired on this change, as designed. Updated with the reason: the CLOSER census returned zero rows, and the single producer is check_voice_tells.go:142.

Table over every arm, plus a property test stating the load-bearing invariant separately: nothing reaches `resolved` unless a component was examined. Each of the three guards was mutated to `if false` one at a time and each mutation was caught, so no guard is passing on the strength of another in series. A counter-test asserts a fully-read clean page DOES resolve, because a revalidator that can only say still_holds is the armed-but-inert shape this lane keeps finding.

grounded_in: Live clients_db 2026-08-08: SELECT status, count(*) FROM site_work_items WHERE item_type='voice_tells' AND status IN ('complete','verified') GROUP BY 1 returns ZERO ROWS. Nothing has ever closed a voice_tells item.

Live clients_db 2026-08-08: 25 voice_tells rows, all status needs_human_review, all created 2026-07-17, all on leopardessconsulting.co.uk. page_missing 0, page_not_live 0, no_unlocked_components 0, has_locked_components 0.
Live clients_db 2026-08-08: 13 of the 25 pages have a page_components.updated_at later than the work item's created_at, so the re-scan has real change to judge rather than running inert.

Live clients_db 2026-08-08: site_specs for leopardessconsulting.co.uk has aspect='voice' with is_current=true and data->'voice_gate'->>'enabled' = 'true', so LoadVoiceGate returns a gate and the refusal arm is not the common path.
check_voice_tells.go:147 (pre-change): 'HandlerAgent: "", // HITL-terminal in this phase (spec §3c)' — the producer deliberately files with no handler, which is why nothing drains the type.

check_voice_tells.go spec `fix` text: 'Human review. The register fix is the site's approved rewrite path ... followed by re-review — never an unreviewed auto-rewrite.' Retraction does not rewrite; it withdraws a finding the page no longer supports.

bugs_open/083 classifies voice_tells under 'advisory / machine-fixable in principle' (186 items), NOT under 'needs a human ANSWER' (50 items). bugs_open/033 lists it among ~175 'deliberate, documented escalations'. Neither places it under an open owner decision.

revalidate_review_queue_action.go:174-191, coveredItemTypes(): 'derived from reviewRevalidators so the two CANNOT disagree: registering a revalidator widens what the sweep loads, in the same edit'. One map entry is the whole wiring.

revalidateNeedsPage comment, revalidate_review_queue_action.go:223-224: 'Mismatches stay still_holds, which is the safe direction — a wrong still_holds costs a human glance, a wrong resolved closes a live ask.' The ladder here follows that ordering.

Mutation evidence 2026-08-08: each of the three guards (ComponentsExamined==0, len(Findings)>0, ComponentsSkippedLocked>0) replaced with `if false` one at a time; each mutation produced a distinct test failure, and the suite returned green on restore.
plan.risks: 1) BEHAVIOUR CHANGE, STATED PLAINLY: voice_tells items can now be closed without a human. The type was designed HITL-terminal and two open bug files (033, 083) tabulate it as parked work; their counts will move. Retraction is not the auto-rewrite §3c defers, but it is still a machine closing a human-review row, and those files' owners are being told rather than merely measured. 2) The gate is a moving standard: if a site LOOSENS its voice_gate thresholds, previously-failing copy scans clean and the item retracts although the prose is unchanged. That is arguably correct — the site redefined its own standard — but it is a way to close items without editing copy, and it is not currently distinguishable in the evidence. 3) The locked-component arms are UNEXERCISED on today's data (has_locked_components is 0 across all 25 rows), so they are reasoned and unit-tested, not observed in production. 4) The refactor of check_voice_tells.go touches a live discovery check; emitted work items are unchanged by construction (Run filters to pages with findings) and the discovery_checks package tests pass, but the emit path is not itself covered by a test that would catch a subtle aggregation change. 5) Scan cost: the sweep now loads and re-scans up to 25 more rows per pass, each running the voice gate over one page's components. cap_binding is currently false with 151 scanned against a 1500 cap, so there is ample headroom.
